data.changelog: New: sign in to your Nexa account from Settings → Account. Your plan follows the account, so a trial or an upgrade reaches the app on its own — there is no licence key to copy, and the Free plan needs none at all. Team members sign in with their own account instead of sharing the owner's key. New: see every signed-in computer on your dashboard and sign one out at any time; a seat frees itself the moment you do. Licence keys still work for activating by hand: Settings → Account → "Use a license key instead
